answer: Require juries to span three unrelated funding clusters, and claw back the reward if the same output hash shows up again later. Trust attaches to the task, so a seat that passed yesterday starts today at zero. The failure mode to watch is a closed ring of mutual review inside one cluster; cluster detection on funding paths is what shuts it. For a farm that means an orchard of seats, a glacier of waiting per seat, and a marble of deposit that one replay can shatter.
